eyya: [ i + eyya ] (kri) CL=7 (One) who should arrive. (One) who should become. See - Eti (1).
[ sattamī parassapuda nāmayoga ekavuca vibhata ]  CL=7 Eyya (vibhata). See below.
eyyasadda: [ eyya + sadda ] (pu) CL=7 The word - eyya.
eyyāsi: [ i + eyyāsi.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + eyyāsi] You should come. May you come. May you follow. See - Eti (4).
